reserve.name: Chase Sapphire Reserve
reserve.subtitle: The travel credit is broad. Most other credits have narrower rules.
perks: General travel credit
Each account year on eligible travel purchases; credited purchases do not earn points.
The Edit hotel credit
Up to $250 per prepaid stay, twice yearly. Two-night minimum through Chase Travel; compare rates.
Sapphire Exclusive Tables dining
Up to $150 in each half of the calendar year at select restaurants on OpenTable.
DoorDash promos
Up to $25 monthly: $5 restaurants plus two $10 nonrestaurant offers. DashPass required; through 2027.
StubHub / viagogo
Up to $150 each half-year. Activation required; through 2027.
Apple TV + Apple Music
Issuer annualized subscription value. Ends June 22, 2027; count only subscriptions you would pay for.
Lyft in-app credits
Up to $10 monthly on eligible rides through September 2027.
Peloton membership
Up to $10 monthly. Activation required; through 2027.
DashPass membership
Issuer value for 12 months; count only if you would otherwise buy it. Activate by end of 2027.
extras: Prepaid, eligible brand, two-night stay. Ends December 31, 2026; not recurring.
Chase Sapphire Lounges and Priority Pass. Chase estimates $850+ for multiple visits; not a cash credit.
Application fee reimbursement once every four years.
Breakfast, property credit and possible upgrades. Do not automatically add this to the hotel credit.
Trip delay, cancellation and rental coverage under policy terms; coverage ceilings are not savings.

welcome.headline: 100,000 Chase points
welcome.detail: After $6,000 in purchases in the first 3 months. Public offer; a referral application may show different terms.

preferred.name: Chase Sapphire Preferred
preferred.subtitle: Fewer credits and a lower annual fee.
perks: Chase Travel hotel credit
Eligible hotels booked through Chase Travel each account anniversary year.
DoorDash promo
Up to $10 monthly on eligible nonrestaurant purchases with DashPass through 2027.
extras: Complimentary membership if activated by end of 2027.
One year complimentary if activated by December 31, 2026.
One application fee reimbursement every four years.
Transferable points; 5× on Chase Travel and 3× dining and select categories.

welcome.headline: 75,000 Chase points
welcome.detail: After $5,000 in purchases in the first 3 months.

venturex.name: Capital One Venture X
venturex.subtitle: The portal credit is valuable if its bookings suit you.
perks: Capital One Travel credit
Annual credit for bookings through Capital One Travel, not a general travel statement credit.
extras: Starts after the first anniversary; worth $100 toward eligible travel at 1¢ per mile.
Capital One Lounges and Priority Pass; check locations and guest rules.
Dollar value depends on spend and redemption.

welcome.headline: 75,000 Capital One miles
welcome.detail: After $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months.

venture.name: Capital One Venture
venture.subtitle: Its headline hotel credit applies in the first year only.
extras: Eligible hotel or vacation-rental bookings through Capital One Travel; not recurring.
Eligible application fee reimbursement, subject to issuer terms.
Experience credit for qualifying bookings; no fixed annual amount.
Dollar value depends on spend and redemption.

welcome.headline: 75,000 Capital One miles
welcome.detail: After $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months. The separate first-year $300 Capital One Travel Stays credit appears under other benefits.

gold.name: American Express Gold
gold.subtitle: The credits add up, but most expire monthly or half-yearly.
perks: Dining credit
Up to $10 monthly at participating restaurants and services; enrollment required.
Uber Cash
Up to $10 monthly on eligible U.S. rides or orders after adding the card to Uber.
Resy credit
Up to $50 each half-year at qualifying U.S. restaurants; enrollment required.
Dunkin’ credit
Up to $7 monthly at U.S. Dunkin’ locations; enrollment required.
extras: Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, subject to caps; value depends on redemption.
Credit on eligible stays of at least two nights, not a general annual credit.

welcome.headline: As high as 100,000 Amex points
welcome.detail: After $8,000 in purchases in the first 6 months. Apply to learn your personalized offer; it may be lower or unavailable.

platinum.name: American Express Platinum
platinum.subtitle: A large menu of credits. The useful total depends on eligible hotels, dining, subscriptions and travel you already buy.
perks: Hotel credit
$300 Jan–Jun and $300 Jul–Dec on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts or The Hotel Collection through Amex Travel. The Hotel Collection requires two nights.
Resy dining credit
Up to $100 each quarter at qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants and eligible Resy purchases; enrollment required.
Digital entertainment credit
Up to $25 monthly on eligible subscriptions from select providers; direct billing and enrollment required.
lululemon credit
Up to $75 each quarter at eligible U.S. stores or lululemon.com; enrollment required.
Equinox credit
Up to $300 each calendar year for an eligible Equinox club membership or Equinox+ subscription; enrollment required.
CLEAR+ credit
Up to $219 each calendar year for an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership, excluding taxes and fees.
Airline incidental fee credit
Up to $200 each calendar year for eligible fees from one selected qualifying airline; airline tickets do not qualify.
Uber Cash
$15 monthly plus $20 extra in December for U.S. rides or Uber Eats; add the card and select an Amex card when paying.
Oura Ring credit
Up to $200 each calendar year on a ring purchased at ouraring.com; enrollment required. Count it only in years you would buy a ring.
Walmart+ membership credit
Up to $12.95 plus applicable tax monthly for one auto-renewing Walmart+ membership; Plus Ups excluded.
Uber One membership credit
Up to $120 per calendar year for an eligible auto-renewing Uber One membership charged to the card.
extras: Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass Select with enrollment, 10 Delta Sky Club visits per year on eligible Delta flights, and select partner lounges. Guest and entry rules apply.
Amex-reported average suite value includes breakfast, an on-property credit, 4 p.m. checkout and possible upgrades. Actual value varies; do not add the full figure automatically to the hotel credit.
Enrollment for Hilton Honors Gold, Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite and Leading Hotels of the World Leaders Club Sterling; upgrades and perks depend on availability.
Application fee credit for Global Entry or up to $85 for a five-year TSA PreCheck application under issuer terms.
Statement credit on a qualifying full-price bike purchase at Equinox+; a 12-month Equinox+ membership is required. Count only if buying a bike.
Eligible flights booked directly or through Amex Travel, up to $500,000 per calendar year; prepaid hotels booked through Amex Travel.
The Hotel Collection, International Airline Program, Cruise Privileges Program, Platinum Destinations Vacations and Amex travel service offer eligible booking perks.
Global Dining Access by Resy, Platinum Nights and select member experiences; no guaranteed cash value.
Enrollment-based status or benefits with participating rental partners; terms differ by program.
Trip delay, cancellation/interruption, baggage, car rental coverage and Premium Global Assist, each subject to policy and eligible payment rules.
Purchase, return, extended warranty and cell phone protection under separate terms; a coverage limit is not a saving.
Amex Offers, concierge and fraud assistance. No foreign transaction fees on eligible purchases.

welcome.headline: As high as 175,000 Amex points
welcome.detail: After $12,000 in purchases in the first 6 months. Apply to learn your personalized offer; it may be lower or unavailable.

bilt.name: Bilt Blue
bilt.subtitle: There is no fixed recurring cash credit; housing points depend on card spending.
extras: Pay through Bilt without a housing transaction fee.
Housing-only choice scales with everyday card spending; another choice uses Bilt Cash to unlock up to 1×.
Points on eligible purchases; value depends on spending and redemption.

welcome.headline: $100 in Bilt Cash
welcome.detail: Awarded when approved, for eligible Bilt ecosystem redemptions; it is not cash back.

palladium.name: Bilt Palladium
palladium.subtitle: Housing payments have no transaction fee, but earning housing points depends on your rewards choice and other card spending.
perks: Bilt Travel Hotel credit
Two $200 credits per year on qualifying Bilt Travel Portal hotel bookings; each stay requires at least two nights.
Annual Bilt Cash
Issued annually for eligible Bilt ecosystem redemptions, not cash back. Up to $100 carries into the next calendar year; value the uses you actually have.
extras: Complimentary cardholder membership with up to two guests per visit; additional guests cost $35 each. A membership price is not guaranteed savings.
Pay through Bilt even when the landlord or lender does not accept cards; housing reward eligibility follows Bilt program rules.
At least 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% of housing amount in eligible card purchases earns 0.5×, 0.75×, 1× or 1.25× on housing, respectively.
Choose instead of housing-only rewards. You may spend Bilt Cash across the ecosystem or use $30 to unlock 1,000 housing points, up to 1×. Do not count it twice.
2× other everyday purchases, up to 5× Bilt partner dining, 4× portal hotels, 3× portal flights and 4× Lyft after linking. Partner rates include base earn.
On the first of each month, eligible everyday purchases earn double points (4× on Palladium); housing payments excluded.
Move Bilt Points to participating airline and hotel loyalty programs; availability and transfer ratios vary.
Trip cancellation/interruption, trip delay, baggage delay, lost or damaged luggage and secondary rental car coverage, subject to guide terms.
Purchase assurance, extended warranty, cell phone protection and price drop protection under guide terms.
The Mastercard Collection, merchant offers and enrolled ID theft protection. No foreign transaction fees.

welcome.headline: 50,000 Bilt points + Gold status
welcome.detail: $4,000 in eligible purchases excluding housing in the first 90 days. Also $300 Bilt Cash upon approval; this is distinct from the recurring $200 annual Bilt Cash.
